basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old nutrition enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I've been on a journey to better health and fitness for the past couple of years, and Reddit has been an invaluable resource. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to experiment with meal planning and workouts. I love cooking, especially trying out new macro-friendly recipes. My online hours vary, but I'm usually active in the evenings. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends hiking and exploring new trails.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in graphic design, but my passion for nutrition and fitness has led me to self-educate extensively through online courses, books, and reliable online communities like Reddit. I've gained practical knowledge by tracking my own macros and experimenting with different dietary approaches.
